entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sorry, I got here a bit early. I've been[n]looking forward to this for some time,[n]so...
entries.uk: Вибач, я прийшла трохи раніше. Я давно[n]чекала на цей фільм,[n]тож...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Th-That is, a famous director was[n]responsible for this movie. Who[n]wouldn't want to see it?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Why are you looking at me like that?[n]Let's go inside already!
entries.uk: Чого ти так на мене дивишся?[n]Ходімо вже всередину!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Let's go inside. I'm so excited...
